intent: The two tangents from a point outside a circle are equally long and meet the radii at right angles

must_show.text: a circle with center O and radius 3
a point P outside the circle, 5 from O
the two tangents from P, touching the circle at T1 and T2
the radii OT1 and OT2, with right-angle marks where they meet the tangents
the chord T1T2, dashed, crossing OP at M
the area between the two tangents and the circle, lightly shaded
the length of the tangents, PT1 = PT2 = sqrt(OP^2 - r^2) = 4, in a framed box

must: the tangents touch the circle exactly at T1 and T2
the formula's box fits the formula
should: the title is the only text in bold

composition_notes: The circle sits left of the middle with P to its right, OP level. The two tangents run from P to the circle and a little past it; the shaded area lies between them and the circle. The formula sits in a box on the right.
